name: Collapse
summary: A single expandable panel that hides secondary content until asked.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-collapse> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the `open` attribute IS the state, and clicking the header toggles it while CSS animates the body height + chevron on a persistent node — the transition always fires. slot="header" is the summary, the default slot the body. Emits a composed `toggle` event.
codeNote: The open/close animation lives on a persistent node (the header toggles the `open` attribute; :host([open]) drives the CSS), so it never dies to a subtree rebuild — the Switch-click trap. `open` is observed, so setting it as a controlled prop keeps both the visuals AND the header's aria-expanded in sync for a screen reader. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Chevron
spec.value: 8×8 border glyph, rotate -45°→45° on open, motion-mid ease-in-out

props.name: open
props.desc: Whether the panel is expanded; toggled on header click

whenToUse.when: hiding secondary detail (advanced settings, an FAQ answer) until wanted
switching between peer views of equal importance
content that should always be visible

opinion.note: Header text names what's inside — 'Advanced settings', not 'More'. Keep panels shallow; deep nesting hides content people never find.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Collapse cell; spec derived from the token layer (radius-default, border, split, bg-hover, icon-default) + antd Collapse conventions. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.
